result.instructions: Tools for Uploadcare, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the files I uploaded most recently and their sizes."; "How many files are in my project, and which is the biggest of the latest ones?"; "Show the details for my newest image upload.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Uploadcare data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run uploadcare_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run uploadcare_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run uploadcare_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. uploadcare_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: uploadcare_get_project
tools.title: Get project
tools.description: Get project details: name, public key, collaborators, and whether autostore is enabled. REST API: GET /project/.

tools.name: uploadcare_list_files
tools.title: List files
tools.description: List files in the project (paginated envelope: next, previous, total, per_page, results). REST API: GET /files/.

stored.description: Filter by stored status (true = stored, false = not stored).

removed.description: Filter by removed status (true = removed, false = present).

from.description: Pagination cursor taken from a previous response's `next` URL.

tools.name: uploadcare_get_file
tools.title: Get file
tools.description: Get full info for a single file: uuid, url, original_filename, size, mime_type, is_image, is_ready, timestamps, variations, content_info, metadata, tags. REST API: GET /files/{uuid}/.

tools.name: uploadcare_get_file_metadata
tools.title: Get file metadata
tools.description: Get all custom metadata key/value pairs for a file. REST API: GET /files/{uuid}/metadata/.

tools.name: uploadcare_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List file groups in the project (paginated envelope: next, previous, total, per_page, results). REST API: GET /groups/.

tools.name: uploadcare_get_group
tools.title: Get group
tools.description: Get info for a single file group by its id. REST API: GET /groups/{uuid}/.

uuid.description: Group id in the form "<uuid>~<count>", e.g. "badfc9f7-...~2".

tools.name: uploadcare_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: List all webhook subscriptions configured for the project. REST API: GET /webhooks/.

tools.name: uploadcare_upload_from_url
tools.title: Upload file from URL
tools.description: Uploads a file into the project from a public URL (additive). Uses the Upload API host with the public key. Returns { type: "token", token } for async ingestion (poll separately) or the file info. Upload API: POST /from_url/.

source_url.description: Public URL of the file to ingest.

store.description: Store the file: "1" = store, "0" = don't store, "auto" = project default. Default "auto".

tools.name: uploadcare_store_file
tools.title: Store file
tools.description: Marks a file as permanently stored (otherwise unstored files are deleted after 24h). Additive. REST API: PUT /files/{uuid}/storage/.

tools.name: uploadcare_delete_file
tools.title: Delete file
tools.description: Permanently deletes a file from the project. Destructive. REST API: DELETE /files/{uuid}/.

tools.name: uploadcare_create_webhook
tools.title: Create webhook
tools.description: Creates a webhook subscription (additive). The project will POST to target_url when the chosen event fires. REST API: POST /webhooks/.

target_url.description: URL the webhook will POST to.

is_active.description: Whether the webhook is active. Default true.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Uploadcare
prompts.description: What you can do with Uploadcare here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: browse_your_latest_uploaded_files
prompts.title: Browse your latest uploaded files
prompts.description: The AI lists files in the project, and opens one to read its name, size, type, whether it is an image, tags and metadata.

prompts.name: check_project_details_and_file_groups
prompts.title: Check project details and file groups
prompts.description: The AI reads the project name, public key, collaborators and autostore setting, and lists file groups.

prompts.name: upload_a_file_from_a_url_or_keep_a_file_stored
prompts.title: Upload a file from a URL, or keep a file stored
prompts.description: The AI uploads a file from a public URL into the project. It can also mark an existing file, by its UUID, as stored so it is kept.

prompts.name: delete_files_you_no_longer_need
prompts.title: Delete files you no longer need
prompts.description: The AI finds a file and deletes it from the project for good. Confirm the file first.

prompts.name: review_and_add_webhooks
prompts.title: Review and add webhooks
prompts.description: The AI lists the webhook subscriptions of the project and can create a new one that posts to a target URL when an event fires.
